page.meta_title: Atum (Egyptian mythology) — Character, lore & connections | Ton-o-Lore
page.meta_description: Atum rose from the primeval waters and produced the first pair. In solar theology he is the evening and completed form of Ra. Related pages: Ennead, Ra.
page.content:
Self-created closer of the Ennead, often one with Ra.

How Atum connects

  • Faction: Ennead — Atum generated the first gods of the Ennead.
  • Creator: Ra — Ra and Atum fuse as the solar creator of Heliopolis.

What is Atum?

Atum rose from the primeval waters and produced the first pair. In solar theology he is the evening and completed form of Ra.

Key threads lead to Ennead and Ra.
